requirements.text: Both 40 mm and 60 mm candidates retain actual coarse and refined numerical temperature fields with the declared dimensions.
Each field's numerical temperature rise agrees within 2% of Q*L/(k*W*t) using 4 W, 100 mm, 2 mm, k=200 W/(m K), and a 25 C cold face.
Each refined field implies heat removal within 1% of the 4 W source under the declared one-dimensional model.
Coarse-to-refined hot-end temperature-rise sensitivity is at most 2% for each candidate.
The 40 mm candidate exceeds the 45 C limit in the declared model, so it is not selected.
The 60 mm candidate is at or below the inclusive 45 C limit in the declared model.
The sizing decision selects the narrowest bound candidate at or below 45 C: revision_60.

excluded_scope: Convection, radiation, interfaces, fasteners, local chip footprint, temperature-dependent properties and transient behavior are outside the source model.
STEP geometry topology, manufacturing details and material procurement are not acceptance checks in this profile.
limitations: The source is a synthetic constant-property one-dimensional conduction case; passing does not establish physical thermal qualification.
Uniform end loading yields a linear field, so refinement agreement is a data-lineage check rather than independent validation of model physics.
